content.short: Jamit gives creators tools to record, edit, distribute and monetize content globally, powered by Web3.
content.description: Creators around the world, especially outside the most developed countries, face barriers to starting and monetizing their content because hosting, bandwidth, and production costs can be prohibitive, and many platforms restrict monetization by location. Jamit provides an all-in-one platform to record, edit, and distribute content globally and monetize their work by receiving crypto coins and tokens, powered by Web3 technology, helping creators reach wider audiences and access new monetization options without geography-based restrictions.
content.meta: Jamit is a Web3 social app that helps creators record, edit, distribute and monetize their content globally. Discover Jamit and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
